references.title: Slings — Safety Standard for Cableways, Cranes, Derricks, Hoists, Hooks, Jacks and Slings
references.summary: Establishes safety requirements for construction, installation, operation, inspection, testing, maintenance, and use of cranes and hoisting equipment.

references.reference: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code (BPVC) Section VIII
references.title: Rules for Construction of Pressure Vessels
references.summary: Provides requirements for design, fabrication, inspection, and certification of boilers and pressure vessels.

references.title: Safety Nets — Safety Requirements, Test Methods
references.summary: Specifies requirements and test methods for safety nets used as collective protection for fall protection in construction.
